name: WordAI
author: softcoy

sections.description:
Create content. Improve on-page SEO. Help visitors find answers.

WordAI brings an AI content writer, AI image generator, SEO scanner and website chatbot into your WordPress dashboard. Draft blog posts and pages, refresh existing articles, review search engine optimization suggestions and answer visitor questions using selected website content.

Choose OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok or DeepSeek for supported text workflows. Switch providers in the content generator without leaving the editor, and keep each provider’s content and image settings separate.

Instead of copying drafts between tools or guessing which page to improve, work from the editor, an SEO issue or a Google Search Console report. Generate only what you need, review proposed changes and decide what to publish.

Explore WordAI features | Getting started | Video tutorials

What can you do with WordAI?

  • Start an article: turn a topic into a blog draft, title, excerpt and tags with Prompt Assistant.
  • Refresh an older post: regenerate selected content or images without rebuilding the entire page.
  • Create a featured image: generate a relevant visual, save it to the Media Library and insert it using your settings.
  • Find what needs fixing: scan on-page SEO, read recommendations and review AI-suggested edits before applying them.
  • Choose what to improve next: use search queries, page performance and available opportunity reports from Google Search Console.
  • Answer recurring questions: build a website AI assistant using the content you select and index.

Each workflow is explained below, with setup guides and availability details.

See WordAI in action

Watch the content, search optimization and website chat overview:

Watch the SEO Scan and AI Auto Fix demonstration: identify an on-page issue, understand the recommendation and review the proposed edit.

See the content and search-ready publishing walkthrough, or visit the SOFTCOY YouTube channel for more WordAI demonstrations. Tutorials can demonstrate additional licensed capabilities; the product page explains availability.

AI blog writer and content generator for posts and pages

Move past a blank editor with a guided brief. Prompt Assistant helps describe the topic, audience and goal so your AI writing request has a clear purpose.

  • Generate a post title, body content, excerpt and tags from the content generation window.
  • Write a manual prompt or use Prompt Assistant to clarify your topic, audience and goal.
  • Choose available language, tone, writing style, paragraph, excerpt and tag settings.
  • Guide headings, search intent and readability for more organized, people-first content.
  • Select only the items you need. Refresh an existing article or regenerate an image without replacing every part of the post.
  • See each item’s progress and review its result separately.
  • Automatically insert generated content and images into the editor when the corresponding settings are enabled.
  • Keep control of publication: review facts, links, wording and images before publishing.

Content generation guide | Writing settings

Title suggestions and editor SEO tools

Find a clearer headline for an existing post or page, then review the details that help explain the page to readers and search engines.

  • Open Suggest Titles from the WordPress content list, generate alternatives and choose the title you want to use.
  • Review SEO title, meta description, focus keyword and search-result preview fields in the WordAI editor sidebar.
  • Manage available canonical, robots and social metadata options in the same editing workspace.
  • Review internal link suggestions, edit the anchor text and destination, and apply or remove links before publishing.
  • Keep linking suggestions out of public content until you choose to apply them.

Internal link suggestions depend on the selected policy in Content Settings. If an anchor is not found in the content, applying its suggestion can add a related link at the end instead.

AI image generator inside WordPress

Create visuals for your articles without leaving the content generation window.

  • Generate images with supported OpenAI, Google Gemini and xAI Grok image models.
  • Review provider-aware image model and output options in Image Settings.
  • Preview a completed image, save it to the WordPress Media Library and select it as the featured image.
  • Use automatic Media Library saving and image insertion when enabled.
  • See generation progress and retain completed results when you cancel remaining work.
  • Get clear guidance when a selected provider does not support image generation.

Image options depend on the selected provider, model and available feature access. Claude and DeepSeek image-generation options are disabled in WordAI; switch to a supported image provider when needed.

Image settings and workflow

WordPress SEO Scan and AI Auto Fix

Unsure what to improve in an existing article? Use the on-page SEO scan to find specific issues instead of guessing.

  • Review scan scores, detected issues and suggested improvements.
  • Check content structure, titles, metadata and focus-keyword usage.
  • Review AI-proposed changes before approving and applying them.
  • Return to the editor to refine the content in context.
  • Use the dashboard summary to see available SEO and content activity at a glance.

An SEO scan score describes the plugin’s on-page checks; Useful, accurate content and editorial review remain essential.

SEO Scan and AI Auto Fix guide

Build clearer content for search and AI discovery

Want your content to be easier to understand in traditional search and AI-powered search experiences? Start with useful answers, descriptive headings, relevant internal links and accurate page information.

WordAI supports that work through structured content drafts, focus-keyword and metadata checks, internal link suggestions, and reviewable SEO fixes. Use these tools to address specific on-page issues, clarify the topic and refresh information that no longer answers your readers’ questions.

Google recommends foundational SEO and helpful, reliable content for its AI search features: Google’s guidance for AI features and websites.

Google Search Console reports in WordPress

Find out which searches bring people to your site and which pages may need attention, without leaving WordPress to start the next edit.

  • Connect an authorized Google account and select a Search Console website property.
  • Review clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position for the displayed reporting period.
  • Explore page and search-query reports, daily trends and available period comparisons.
  • Review available content-decay findings and queries where different pages compete.
  • Open matching WordPress content through review or SEO Scan actions.
  • Check connection, property selection and synchronization status when reports are not yet available.

Reports use Google Search Console data through SOFTCOY services. Report history, refresh frequency and available findings depend on service access. Search Console connections are shared across AI providers.

Search Console setup and reporting

Website AI chatbot with your content as its knowledge base

Give visitors another way to explore your website instead of searching through several pages for an answer. Your enabled AI chat assistant can respond using selected, indexed content while your site and AI service are available.

  • Choose content items in AI Chat Agent and index them for use as website knowledge.
  • Review the selected items and indexing confirmation before starting work.
  • Keep checked, indexed content available for visitor answers; unchecked items are excluded.
  • Skip already indexed content when appropriate, or deliberately re-index changed content.
  • Reuse eligible content indexed through another provider when the corresponding setting is enabled.
  • Configure the chat greeting, assistant label, reply model, tone, conversation font size and widget position.
  • Choose whether the chat widget is available publicly or only to logged-in visitors.
  • Review available conversation history, feedback and unanswered-question insights in Chat Analytics.
  • Use the available visitor-name capture option to add context to conversations.

This is retrieval from selected website content, not training a new AI model. Chat answers depend on the available knowledge, provider response and your settings. Review analytics to identify information your site could explain more clearly.

Knowledge-base indexing | Chat settings | Chat analytics

More workflows as your website grows

WordAI also offers separately licensed capabilities for WooCommerce product descriptions, generated SEO metadata and image alt text, scheduled SEO scans, expanded image controls, larger knowledge bases and deeper reporting. Additional chat capabilities include custom logos and footer branding, visitor contact fields, lead exports and contact handoff settings.

These capabilities are not all included in this download. Included scanning, indexing, image and reporting workflows have usage limits. See the WordAI product details for current availability, examples and settings before choosing a workflow.

Who is WordAI for?

  • Bloggers who need help drafting articles, creating images and refreshing older posts.
  • Small-business website owners who want clearer service pages and helpful visitor answers.
  • Content editors who prefer working directly in WordPress with control over each generated item.
  • Website teams reviewing search performance and deciding which pages need attention.
  • Site owners building a content-based chatbot without writing a custom integration.

Start with your first draft

  1. Install and activate WordAI.
  2. Open WordAI > API Settings, choose a provider and save its API key.
  3. Review Content Settings and, for an image-capable provider, Image Settings.
  4. Open a post or page and click the WordAI button in the editor.
  5. Enter a prompt or use Prompt Assistant, then choose the items to generate.
  6. Review the results, insert them or use your enabled auto-insertion settings, and publish when ready.

AI generation and chat require your own provider account and API key. Provider charges and account limits may apply separately. Google Search Console reports require an authorized connection and a selected property.

Help, tutorials and updates

  • Learn a workflow: read the WordAI documentation for setup instructions and screenshots.
  • Watch before you try: subscribe to the SOFTCOY YouTube channel for content creation, SEO and AI chat demonstrations.
  • Follow product updates: follow SOFTCOY on Facebook for new WordAI features, short how-to videos and practical website tips.
  • Get installation help: use WordAI > Support or visit SOFTCOY support.

External Services and Privacy

WordAI connects to external services when you use the corresponding features. AI requests send prompts, selected content or conversation context and request settings to the configured provider. Indexing sends selected content for embeddings. Use only information you are authorized to share; provider charges and policies apply.

  • OpenAI: api.openai.com – Privacy policy.
  • Google Gemini: generativelanguage.googleapis.com – Privacy policy.
  • Anthropic Claude: api.anthropic.com – Privacy policy.
  • xAI Grok: api.x.ai – Privacy policy.
  • DeepSeek: api.deepseek.com – Privacy policy.
  • Voyage AI: api.voyageai.com, used by the Claude indexing integration with a separate Voyage key; selected content and retrieval queries are sent for embeddings – Privacy policy.

SOFTCOY services: Search Console reporting uses your Google authorization, connection/site identifiers, selected properties, report dates and performance data. Support sends the contact details, message, attachments and diagnostics you submit. License requests use the entered license and site details when you use those workflows. See the SOFTCOY privacy policy and support policy.

Optional email updates: nothing is sent until you review the email, check consent and click Get Updates. Only the entered email, plugin choice and consent/version go to https://softcoy.com/api/v1/email-updates/subscribe. Marketing starts only after email confirmation. This feature sends no website URL, location, license or other WordPress user information. Subscription is optional; dismiss for 30 days, hide permanently or reopen from Support.

Chat and media: visitor conversations and enabled lead fields can be stored on your website for chat reports. Configure consent and your privacy notice before collection. Embedded tutorials use YouTube, and some admin styles load Google Fonts; these connections expose standard browser request information to Google under its privacy policy linked above.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New, search for WordAI, and click Install Now.
  2. Activate the plugin. Alternatively, upload its ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Open WordAI > API Settings and save the API key for your selected provider.
  4. Review the provider’s Content Settings and Image Settings before generating.
  5. Open a post or page, click WordAI, enter your prompt and generate the selected items.
  6. To configure a website chatbot, open WordAI > AI Chat Agent, select and index the content you want it to use, then review AI Chat Settings.
  7. To view search reports, open Search Console, authorize your Google connection and select a property.
sections.faq:
What does WordAI do?

WordAI combines an AI content writer, image generator, on-page SEO tools, Search Console reports and a content-based website chatbot in WordPress. Start with a post draft, an existing page to improve or website content you want visitors to find through chat.

Do I need a ChatGPT subscription or an API key?

WordAI connects to provider APIs using your own API key. A ChatGPT website subscription is not the same as an OpenAI API account. Save the key for your selected provider in WordAI > API Settings. Provider usage charges and account limits may apply.

Which AI providers can I choose?

WordAI integrates OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok and DeepSeek for supported text and chat workflows. Choose an available model in API Settings or AI Chat Settings. Capabilities and model access vary by provider.

Can I generate both text and images with every provider?

No. WordAI supports image generation with compatible OpenAI, Google Gemini and xAI Grok models. Its Claude and DeepSeek integrations handle text and chat, not image generation. Unsupported image and image-alt-text generation options are disabled in the content generator.

How do I use Prompt Assistant?

Open WordAI in the post or page editor, choose a template and complete the available prompt fields. Prompt Assistant helps describe what you want to write and who it is for. You can also type a manual prompt. Review the prompt-ready feedback before generating.

Can I improve an existing post without replacing everything?

Yes. Open WordAI while editing the post and select only the items you need, such as the title, body content or image. Review automatic insertion settings first, because enabled insertion can replace the corresponding editor content. Save a revision and review the result before publishing.

Can WordAI generate WordPress tags and excerpts?

Yes. Select Tags or Excerpt in the content generator and use a text-capable provider with a saved API key. These are separate results, so you can generate or retry them without generating a new article.

Are generated images saved and inserted automatically?

That depends on Image Settings. Enable Media Library saving and the relevant insertion options for the supported workflow. A generated image must be saved to the Media Library before it can be selected as a featured image.

Why do settings change when I switch AI providers?

WordAI saves provider-aware settings separately. Switching providers loads the selected provider’s options rather than applying another provider’s model or image configuration. Your Search Console connection does not need to be recreated when you switch AI providers.

What should I do when generation fails or stops early?

Open the affected result tab and read the error. Check the saved API key, model availability, provider balance or quota, output settings and server connectivity. Retry only the failed item when possible. Resetting the selected provider’s settings can help undo an unsuitable configuration, but will not resolve provider outages or exhausted quotas.

Does WordAI automatically publish AI-generated content?

The editor workflow creates results for you to review and insert. You remain responsible for checking accuracy, originality, image suitability and links before publishing. Generated content and SEO recommendations apply correctly will make higher rankings or traffic.

How do internal link suggestions work?

The selected Internal Link Policy controls suggestions. Review the destination and use text copied from your article as the anchor, then click Apply. If the anchor is missing, a related link may be added at the end. Remove lets you undo the applied suggestion. Suggestions are not automatically published as a list of editing instructions.

Can I keep using my existing SEO plugin?

WordAI includes SEO compatibility controls. Review the active metadata settings and avoid having multiple tools output conflicting titles, canonical tags or social metadata. Test your chosen configuration on your site.

Can WordAI help with visibility in AI search results?

WordAI helps improve the content and on-page SEO foundations that also matter for AI-powered search: clear topics, organized headings, useful answers and relevant internal links. It does not track AI citations or guarantee inclusion in AI answers. Its website chatbot is a separate feature that answers visitors on your own site.

How does the chatbot use my website content?

Select and index content in AI Chat Agent. Checked, indexed items are available as knowledge for frontend answers; unchecked items are excluded even if previously indexed. Indexing is not model fine-tuning. If no relevant knowledge is available, the assistant may be unable to answer.

Must I index the same content again when changing chat providers?

Not always. The embedded-content source and cross-provider reuse settings let supported chat workflows use eligible existing knowledge. Keep the relevant content selected. Re-index when the content changes or when a different indexing configuration is needed, rather than repeating unchanged work unnecessarily.

Where do I review chat conversations and captured visitor information?

Open AI Chat Agent > Chat Analytics for the available conversation, feedback and visitor reports. Contact-field availability, history and exports depend on feature access. Configure consent wording and your privacy policy before collecting visitor information.

Why does Search Console show no data?

Confirm that Google authorization is complete and a website property is selected. Check the reporting period and synchronization status. An unselected property, unfinished sync or a property without search activity can produce an empty report. See the Search Console guide.

Why do Search Console rows not always add up to the total?

Google property totals and detailed page or query reports are different aggregations. Privacy filtering and row limits can affect the visible rows. Compare the same property, period, search type and data freshness when checking against Google Search Console.

How do I use Search Console findings to improve a page?

Use the available review or SEO Scan action to open matching WordPress content. Review issues, edit the page and approve appropriate suggestions. Search reporting will reflect changes only after Google processes the page and new data is synchronized.

Where can I see all available WordAI workflows?

Visit the WordAI product page and documentation for demonstrations, configuration guides and availability. Some advanced workflows require a separate license.

  • Get clear guidance when a selected provider does not support image generation.

Image options depend on the selected provider, model and available feature access. Claude and DeepSeek image-generation options are disabled in WordAI; switch to a supported image provider when needed.

Want your content to be easier to understand in traditional search and AI-powered search experiences? Start with useful answers, descriptive headings, relevant internal links and accurate page information.

WordAI supports that work through structured content drafts, focus-keyword and metadata checks, internal link suggestions, and reviewable SEO fixes. Use these tools to address specific on-page issues, clarify the topic and refresh information that no longer answers your readers’ questions.

Google Search Console reports in WordPress

Find out which searches bring people to your site and which pages may need attention, without leaving WordPress to start the next edit.

  • Connect an authorized Google account and select a Search Console website property.
  • Review clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position for the displayed reporting period.
  • Explore page and search-query reports, daily trends and available period comparisons.
  • Review available content-decay findings and queries where different pages compete.
  • Open matching WordPress content through review or SEO Scan actions.
  • Check connection, property selection and synchronization status when reports are not yet available.

Reports use Google Search Console data through SOFTCOY services. Report history, refresh frequency and available findings depend on service access. Search Console connections are shared across AI providers.

Website AI chatbot with your content as its knowledge base

Give visitors another way to explore your website instead of searching through several pages for an answer. Your enabled AI chat assistant can respond using selected, indexed content while your site and AI service are available.

  • Choose content items in AI Chat Agent and index them for use as website knowledge.
  • Review the selected items and indexing confirmation before starting work.
  • Keep checked, indexed content available for visitor answers; unchecked items are excluded.
  • Skip already indexed content when appropriate, or deliberately re-index changed content.
  • Reuse eligible content indexed through another provider when the corresponding setting is enabled.
  • Configure the chat greeting, assistant label, reply model, tone, conversation font size and widget position.
  • Choose whether the chat widget is available publicly or only to logged-in visitors.
  • Review available conversation history, feedback and unanswered-question insights in Chat Analytics.
  • Use the available visitor-name capture option to add context to conversations.

This is retrieval from selected website content, not training a new AI model. Chat answers depend on the available knowledge, provider response and your settings. Review analytics to identify information your site could explain more clearly.

Start with your first draft

  1. Install and activate WordAI.

External Services and Privacy

WordAI connects to external services when you use the corresponding features. AI requests send prompts, selected content or conversation context and request settings to the configured provider. Indexing sends selected content for embeddings. Use only information you are authorized to share; provider charges and policies apply.

  • OpenAI: api.openai.com – Privacy policy.
  • Google Gemini: generativelanguage.googleapis.com – Privacy policy.
  • Anthropic Claude: api.anthropic.com – Privacy policy.
  • xAI Grok: api.x.ai – Privacy policy.
  • DeepSeek: api.deepseek.com – Privacy policy.
  • Voyage AI: api.voyageai.com, used by the Claude indexing integration with a separate Voyage key; selected content and retrieval queries are sent for embeddings – Privacy policy.

SOFTCOY services: Search Console reporting uses your Google authorization, connection/site identifiers, selected properties, report dates and performance data. Support sends the contact details, message, attachments and diagnostics you submit. License requests use the entered license and site details when you use those workflows. See the SOFTCOY privacy policy and support policy.

Optional email updates: nothing is sent until you review the email, check consent and click Get Updates. Only the entered email, plugin choice and consent/version go to https://softcoy.com/api/v1/email-updates/subscribe. Marketing starts only after email confirmation. This feature sends no website URL, location, license or other WordPress user information. Subscription is optional; dismiss for 30 days, hide permanently or reopen from Support.

Chat and media: visitor conversations and enabled lead fields can be stored on your website for chat reports. Configure consent and your privacy notice before collection. Embedded tutorials use YouTube, and some admin styles load Google Fonts; these connections expose standard browser request information to Google under its privacy policy linked above.
